proves.claim: A head whose new commits name only a withdrawn item is not refused WRONG_BRANCH, so a replacement item submits.

cli.io-submit-wrong-branch.withdrawn-ite.why: Without it, carried commits that name a withdrawn item block every submit of its replacement.

proves.claim: A head whose new commits name an open other item and none of this item is still refused WRONG_BRANCH.

cli.io-submit-wrong-branch.live-item-ref.why: Without it, ignoring withdrawn items could let a branch be gated as the wrong live item.

proves.claim: refuseUnsubmittableStack passes its board to the wrong-branch check on a fixture board and repo.

cli.io-submit-wrong-branch.stack-path.why: Without it, the board read could exist in the check but never be reached from the submit path.
